research_question: Does a causal 0.05% directional-change confirmation on native XAUUSD midquote identify a sparse intrinsic-time state transition whose same-direction overshoot survives frozen P75 execution costs over the DELTA 30-second initial-hold lifecycle?
source_basis: Directional-change literature defines events by a reversal threshold from a local extreme and documents overshoot as the continuation following a directional-change confirmation.
BRACIL directional-change FX sample summaries use a fixed 0.05% threshold for EURGBP/EURUSD/GBPUSD.
Published high-frequency FX scaling-law work reports average overshoot length approximately proportional to the directional-change threshold.

frozen_signal.event: causal directional-change confirmation from running local extreme
frozen_signal.execution_tick: first strictly subsequent canonical tick after confirmation

failure_rule: If the single 0.05% continuation profile fails the ordinary direct-net gate, retire DCOS rather than rescue it on Stage-A.
advance_rule: If it passes supply/day and direct-net gates, freeze unchanged for independent later-January validation.
